sources.entry: KeepingYouAwake - Caffeine alternative with dark mode support. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/newmarcel/KeepingYouAwake)
KeepingYouAwake - Prevents your Mac from going to sleep.

summary.one_liner: KeepingYouAwake is a small macOS menu bar utility that keeps your Mac from sleeping for a set duration or for as long as it is switched on.
summary.what_it_does: The app is a menu bar wrapper around Apple's built-in caffeinate command line tool. It can prevent the Mac from entering sleep mode either for a predefined duration or until it is turned off manually. The README says it requires macOS 10.13 or newer. It can be installed by downloading the latest release or via Homebrew cask. The author states it will not keep a MacBook awake with the lid closed; it only prevents sleep on desktop Macs and portable Macs with an open lid. The README also lists older release versions for legacy macOS releases (1.6.8 for Big Sur and older, 1.6.2 for Sierra, 1.5.2 for Yosemite and El Capitan).
use_cases: stop screen from locking while reading
keep mac awake for a set time
menu bar caffeine replacement on mac
how_to_run: Download the latest version from the GitHub releases page
notable: Wraps Apple's official caffeinate utility rather than using custom sleep hacks
Timed or indefinite sleep prevention from the menu bar
Inspired by the older Caffeine app by Lighthead Software
Older versions still published for legacy macOS releases
caveats: Does not prevent sleep when a MacBook lid is closed
Requires macOS 10.13 or newer for the current version
Author provides no guarantee; use at your own risk
